title: Securing Proprietary Logistics Microservices
business: Logistics firms managing proprietary routing algorithms in containerized microservices.
problem: Unsecured public image repositories lead to intellectual property leakage and unauthorized access to sensitive deployment artifacts.
solution: Azure Container Registry provides a private, managed environment to store and secure container images and OCI artifacts, ensuring only authenticated services can pull proprietary code.
steps: Provision an Azure Container Registry instance within the private virtual network.
Configure Azure Role-Based Access Control to restrict push and pull permissions to specific service principals.
Enable content trust to ensure only signed images are deployed to the production environment.
Integrate the registry with Azure Kubernetes Service for seamless, authenticated image retrieval.
outcome: Enhanced security posture through centralized, private storage of containerized assets with granular access control.
limitation: Registry throughput and latency are subject to regional availability; check performance by monitoring pull duration metrics in Azure Monitor.
